title: Everything the server makes stays within one storage budget the operator sets
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "Storage stays bounded. The collection is stored once, as it is. Everything made from it is made when a viewer needs it, kept while it is used, and held within a budget the operator sets." The engine's cleanup is carried over here, with the audit's cleanup findings addressed (D-20261128-audit-findings).
acceptanceCriteria: An operator sets one storage budget for everything the server makes; what is made stays within it, and what nobody has used for a stated time is removed.
Nothing a playback in progress needs is removed for the budget; when what is in use alone exceeds it, the operator is told.
A viewer who starts a film at the moment its made pieces are being removed plays without a restart.
Each kind of cleanup runs once across the cluster, whatever the number of workers, and judges what to keep by one rule from start to end.
The operator can see what is made, its size against the budget, and why it is kept.
A fresh install with nothing made yet reports no error from cleanup.
notes: Versions made ahead are a later choice of the operator's and go first under the budget when they come (Making rule 5).
